day4_arrive.name: Me
day4_arrive.text: *I arrived at the meeting spot. Still a bit early.*

day4_arrive_nervous.name: Me
day4_arrive_nervous.text: *My palms are clammy inside my pockets. Why am I this nervous? Deep breath.*

day4_arrive_people.name: Me
day4_arrive_people.text: *I looked around. Couples walking arm in arm, a family sharing ice cream, someone walking their dog.*

day4_arrive_phone.name: Me
day4_arrive_phone.text: *Pulled out my phone to check the time. Fifteen minutes early. No messages yet.*

day4_arrive_look.name: Me
day4_arrive_look.text: *Snuck a glance at my reflection in a shop window. Do I look okay? ...Probably.*

day4_arrive_wait.name: Me
day4_arrive_wait.text: *This isn't just any hangout. The feeling that something will change after today is gripping my throat.*

day4_meet_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_meet_seoyeon.text: "Already here? Deduction. You're obviously here early because you were excited."

day4_seoyeon_react.name: Me
day4_seoyeon_react.text: *Seoyeon walked over with an easy confidence. She looks different outside of school.*

day4_seoyeon_blush.name: Seoyeon
day4_seoyeon_blush.text: "...What, out of nowhere. Give a girl some warning before you say stuff like that. ...Thanks."

day4_seoyeon_happy.name: Seoyeon
day4_seoyeon_happy.text: "Obviously. I put in the effort today. At least you noticed -- points for that."

day4_yuna_angry_greeting.name: Yuna
day4_yuna_angry_greeting.text: "...You showed up. So why'd you lie to me yesterday?"

day4_yuna_react.name: Me
day4_yuna_react.text: *Yuna was standing in front of the cafe. She gives off a completely different vibe outside of school.*

day4_yuna_blush.name: Yuna
day4_yuna_blush.text: "...Nobody's ever said that to me before. ...Thanks."

day4_dain_react.name: Me
day4_dain_react.text: *Dain was waving and running toward me. Meeting outside school hits different.*

day4_dain_blush.name: Dain
day4_dain_blush.text: "Heheh...! Really?! I agonized over this outfit FOREVER!! Oh thank god~!!"

day4_dain_energy.name: Dain
day4_dain_energy.text: "Nailed it!! I'm in peak condition today!! Come on, let's GO!!"

day4_meet_nurse.name: Nurse
day4_meet_nurse.text: "Oh, you're already here? Have you been waiting long?"

day4_nurse_react.name: Me
day4_nurse_react.text: *The nurse was waving at the museum entrance. Outside of school, the whole atmosphere is different.*

day4_nurse_compliment.name: Me
choices: "Seeing you outside school feels so different."

day4_nurse_blush.name: Nurse
day4_nurse_blush.text: "Heh, thank you. So today, can I see you as a man instead of a student?"

day4_nurse_smile.name: Nurse
day4_nurse_smile.text: "Yeah, I'm a bit nervous too. Today I'm just me. Not anyone's nurse."

day4_meet_teacher.name: Teacher
day4_meet_teacher.text: "You made it. Figured you'd be late, but look at you being punctual."

day4_teacher_react.name: Me
day4_teacher_react.text: *Teacher was standing in front of the cafe. In casual clothes, I almost didn't recognize her.*

day4_teacher_blush.name: Teacher
day4_teacher_blush.text: "...Don't just spring that on me. It's disarming. Stop."

day4_teacher_casual.name: Teacher
day4_teacher_casual.text: "Right? The coffee here is legit. Let's head in."

day4_date_walk.name: Me
day4_date_walk.text: *We walked side by side, talking about everything and nothing. A relaxed air, nothing like school.*

day4_date_talk_1.name: Me
day4_date_talk_1.text: *Things we never got to talk about. Favorite music, childhood dreams, random little hobbies.*

day4_date_talk_2.name: Me
day4_date_talk_2.text: *The longer we talked, the closer the gap between us felt. I wished this moment would freeze.*

day4_date_weather.name: Me
day4_date_weather.text: *A breeze drifted by. Cotton candy clouds floated lazily across the sky.*

day4_date_surroundings.name: Me
day4_date_surroundings.text: *Couples like us dotted the streets everywhere. The thought crossed my mind -- 'Do we look like that too?'*

day4_date_time_pass.name: Me
day4_date_time_pass.text: *I checked my phone and an hour had already vanished. Time got pickpocketed.*

day4_date_sunshine.name: Me
day4_date_sunshine.text: *Sunlight filtering through leaves landed on the face beside me. ...Beautiful.*

day4_activity_seoyeon_1.name: Seoyeon
day4_activity_seoyeon_1.text: "Look over there. Flower garden. Let's take a lap."

day4_activity_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day4_activity_seoyeon_2.text: *Seoyeon walked ahead naturally, beckoning me. Her face lit up among the colorful flowers when she turned around.*

day4_activity_seoyeon_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_activity_seoyeon_3.text: "Ducks over there. Want to feed them? I bought bread at the convenience store ahead of time. This is what being prepared looks like."

day4_activity_seoyeon_4.name: Me
day4_activity_seoyeon_4.text: *We sat side by side tossing bread to the ducks. When they came waddling over, Seoyeon burst into laughter. I could listen to that laugh all day.*

day4_activity_yuna_1.name: Yuna
day4_activity_yuna_1.text: "...Can we stop by the bookstore? There's a book I want to read."

day4_activity_yuna_2.name: Me
day4_activity_yuna_2.text: *We browsed side by side inside the bookstore. Yuna's expression gets so serious when she's picking a book that it felt wrong to interrupt.*

day4_activity_yuna_3.name: Yuna
day4_activity_yuna_3.text: "...Do you like this song? Here, take one side."

day4_activity_yuna_4.name: Me
day4_activity_yuna_4.text: *Yuna handed me one earbud. We sat close, sharing the same music. Her shoulder brushed lightly against mine.*

day4_activity_dain_1.name: Dain
day4_activity_dain_1.text: "HEY HEY, an arcade!! Right there!! LET'S GO!!"

day4_activity_dain_2.name: Me
day4_activity_dain_2.text: *Dain's eyes lit up as she bolted inside. She planted herself in front of a rhythm game with a look of pure challenge.*

day4_activity_dain_3.name: Dain
day4_activity_dain_3.text: "We're BATTLING!! Loser buys ice cream!! I am NOT losing!!"

day4_activity_dain_4.name: Me
day4_activity_dain_4.text: *I lost. Dain threw both fists in the air, cheering. I lost, sure, but seeing that face -- can't even be mad about it.*

day4_activity_nurse_1.name: Nurse
day4_activity_nurse_1.text: "Isn't this painting lovely? The warm colors just keep pulling my eyes back."

day4_activity_nurse_2.name: Me
day4_activity_nurse_2.text: *The museum was quiet and spacious. We walked slowly, viewing paintings side by side. I could get used to moments like this.*

day4_activity_nurse_3.name: Nurse
day4_activity_nurse_3.text: "I had so many dreams when I was a student too. I still do -- they've just changed shape a little."

day4_activity_nurse_4.name: Me
day4_activity_nurse_4.text: *She paused in front of one painting. Her profile in that moment -- quietly, unexpectedly beautiful.*

day4_activity_teacher_1.name: Teacher
day4_activity_teacher_1.text: "What do you want to do after graduation? Got any dreams?"

day4_activity_teacher_2.name: Me
day4_activity_teacher_2.text: *Sitting across from each other in the cafe, talking. Teacher seemed softer than usual.*

day4_activity_teacher_3.name: Teacher
day4_activity_teacher_3.text: "I never thought I'd become a teacher when I was a student. Life doesn't follow the plan. But right now... it's not bad."

day4_activity_teacher_4.name: Me
day4_activity_teacher_4.text: *She sliced a piece of her cake and slid it onto my plate. "Try this, the desserts here are actually amazing." That casual gesture made my heart race.*

day4_activity_converge.name: Me
day4_activity_converge.text: *Time moves fast. It's already almost lunch.*

day4_date_lunch.name: Me
day4_date_lunch.text: *We ducked into a nearby cafe. Sitting across from each other by the window -- heart rate spiking again.*

day4_lunch_menu.name: Me
day4_lunch_menu.text: *Flipping through the menu. Pasta, sandwiches, brunch set.*

day4_lunch_order.name: Me
day4_lunch_order.text: "I'll go with the pasta. What are you getting?"

day4_lunch_order_react.name: Me
day4_lunch_order_react.text: *They picked something too. After ordering, a brief awkward silence settled in.*

day4_lunch_awkward.name: Me
day4_lunch_awkward.text: *Feel like I should say something. What's natural in a moment like this?*

day4_lunch_funny.name: Me
day4_lunch_funny.text: *The food arrived. My pasta portion is beyond anything I imagined. They couldn't hold back their laughter.*

day4_lunch_funny_react.name: Me
day4_lunch_funny_react.text: "Why are you laughing! I can totally handle this!"

day4_lunch_share.name: Me
day4_lunch_share.text: *We ended up sharing each other's food. Every time our forks clinked, laughter slipped out on its own.*

day4_date_lunch_talk.name: Me
day4_date_lunch_talk.text: *The conversation bloomed. Laughing together, mulling things over together. So this is what happiness feels like.*

day4_lunch_learn.name: Me
day4_lunch_learn.text: *The longer we talked, the more new sides I discovered. Favorite season, foods they hate, childhood nicknames. The little things felt precious.*

day4_date_lunch_choice.name: Me
choices: "Honestly... I was pretty lonely before I transferred here."
"I've met genuinely good people since coming to this school."

day4_date_honest.name: Me
day4_date_honest.text: "The new environment scared me too, but thanks to you, every day feels a little different now."

day4_date_honest_react.name: Me
day4_date_honest_react.text: *They listened quietly to my story. A warm nod, gentle eyes. Felt like the sincerity landed.*

day4_date_grateful.name: Me
day4_date_grateful.text: "Especially... right now is the best part."

day4_date_grateful_react.name: Me
day4_date_grateful_react.text: *They glanced away with a small smile. Definitely happy.*

day4_date_response.name: Me
day4_date_response.text: *Their eyes softened. Something just clicked between us.*

day4_date_cafe_exit.name: Me
day4_date_cafe_exit.text: *Stepping out of the cafe, warm afternoon sun. The gap between us felt smaller than before.*

day4_date_photo_moment.name: Me
day4_date_photo_moment.text: *Suddenly I wanted to capture this moment.*
choices: *I'll keep this one in my memory.*

day4_date_photo_yes.name: Me
day4_date_photo_yes.text: *We stood side by side and took a selfie. Two people smiling on screen. A photo I want to keep forever.*

day4_date_photo_no.name: Me
day4_date_photo_no.text: *Sharper than any photo, I burned it into memory. The scent of the wind, the warmth of the sun, the smile of the person beside me.*

day4_date_ending_moment.name: Me
day4_date_ending_moment.text: *Walking side by side, silence fell. Not the awkward kind. The kind where words aren't needed anymore.*

day4_date_ending_feel.name: Me
day4_date_ending_feel.text: *Today feels like a dream. I genuinely never thought a day like this would come after transferring.*

day4_date_transition.name: Me
day4_date_transition.text: *The afternoon still stretches ahead. This date isn't over yet.*
